name: Coal India Ltd.
about: Coal India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells coal and coal products in India. The company offers coking coal for steel making and metallurgical industries, as well as for hard coke manufacturing; semi coking coal for blend-able coal in steel making, merchant coke manufacturing, and other metallurgical industries; and non-coking coal for cement, fertilizer, glass, ceramic, paper, chemical, and brick manufacturing, as well as power generation and other heating purposes. It also provides washed and beneficiated coal for manufacturing of hard coke for steel making and power generation, as well as for cement, sponge iron, and other industrial plants; middling products for power generation, domestic fuel plants, brick manufacturing units, cement plants, and industrial plants, etc.; and reject products for fluidized bed combustion boilers for power generation, road rep

verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~-7% a year growth, below the ~3% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
Trades at PE 7 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 16 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, most of the 16% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 4 → 7), not earnings growth (1% a year).
